subject.title: fix(whatsapp): allow openKeyedStore access during plugin initialization

question: Should this PR be rewritten to trust official ClawHub WhatsApp installs through install-record, catalog, and path provenance instead of a bundled-id missing-record fallback?
rationale: The fix decides which external plugin code receives persistent state and ingress queue access, so the predicate needs owner approval rather than an id-based workaround.

options.title: Require provenance-based rewrite
options.body: Replace the hard-coded id fallback with a narrow official-install trust propagation fix and denial coverage for untracked workspace plugins.

options.title: Hold for broader trust design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers settle the external-plugin trust model for workspace-origin official installs.

options.title: Close this workaround
options.body: Decline the missing-record workaround and ask for a fresh PR against the manifest/install provenance path.

recommendation.title: Require provenance-based rewrite
recommendation.body: Replace the hard-coded id fallback with a narrow official-install trust propagation fix and denial coverage for untracked workspace plugins.
